WingFoil-Version: 0.3.1 (unknown)

Apply a coupon to the subtotal after volume discounts

The coupon was computed on the gross total, so an order with a volume discount
and a percentage coupon got more off than the README allows: 12 × €5.00 with
10% off gave €48.00 of goods instead of €48.60. The base is now the gross
total less the volume discounts. The 50% cap still applies.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Accept a coupon on its last day

A coupon is valid from its first day to its last day, both included, but the
last day was refused as expired. The check is now strictly after the last day.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
